title: Can I OUTSMART Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess online vs humans, with the 'Give me whatever' drawback setting so he gets unfamiliar drawbacks; goal: win three games. Game 1 lost (My Kingdom for a Horse: opponent captured a knight). Wins games 2-4 with Jumpy, Enormous (Fischer-random home-row requirement) and Theocracy; opponents had Krenolations, Colorblind, Separation Anxiety, Bongcloud.
rules: Each player has one random drawback; own visible, opponent's revealed at the end ('info board'). Difficulty selector 'Give me whatever'.
King capture wins; drawbacks can cause instant losses.

Own drawbacks seen: My Kingdom for a Horse — if your opponent captures a knight, you lose. Jumpy — when possible, you must move a piece that is being attacked. Enormous — on or before move 20 all your remaining non-pawn pieces must be on your home row on a square they could not have started on (Fischer-random). Theocracy — on even-numbered moves you can only capture with bishops.

Opponent drawbacks seen: Krenolations — your pawns can only move to light squares. Colorblind — can't move to squares of one colour, re-randomized every turn. Separation Anxiety — pawns adjacent to your king cannot make moves that leave the squares adjacent to him (the king can leave them). Bongcloud — when your king is on the back rank, you can only move pawns and kings.
win_condition: Capture the king / opponent loses by drawback; goal 3 wins (achieved 3 of 4).
